items.w: עזרי מעם יהוה עשה שמים וארץ
items.title: HELP
items.quote: My help is from Hashem, Maker of heaven and earth.
items.text: When you are faced with difficulties, look to Hashem. He created the world you live in and He is the only One Who can help you.

items.w: הנה לא ינום ולא יישן שומר ישראל
items.title: ALWAYS THERE
items.quote: Indeed, He does not slumber and He does not sleep, the Guardian of Yisrael.
items.text: You can be sure that Hashem is watching over you every minute of the day. Even when you are asleep, He is awake.

items.w: יהוה ישמרך מכל רע ישמר את נפשך
items.title: UNIVERSAL PROTECTION
items.quote: Hashem protects you from every evil. He protects your soul.
items.text: Hashem protects you from being swept away by cultural influences.

items.w: יהוה ישמר צאתך ובואך מעתה ועד עולם
items.title: ETERNAL PROTECTION
items.quote: Hashem watches over your departure and your arrival, from now and forever.
items.text: Hashem will always be there to protect you, even when you are far away from home, even when you are enduring the sufferings of Exile.
